description: This source file defines FastAPI API routes for processing EDI 837 files, including endpoints for processing single files or batches, and fetching job status. It utilizes dependency injection for a singleton JobManager and organizes routes under the 'processing' prefix.

classes.name: JobResponse
classes.description: Schema representing the response containing job ID and status.

classes.name: JobStatusResponse
classes.description: Schema for returning the current status and details of a background job.

classes.name: FileProcessRequest
classes.description: Schema representing a request to process a single file, either via blob reference or direct upload.

classes.name: BatchProcessRequest
classes.description: Schema for batch processing input parameters, including input and output containers.

methods.name: JobManager get_job_manager()
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton JobManager instance.

methods.name: JobResponse process_file( background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, payload: Optional[FileProcessRequest] = Body(None, description="Blob reference payload"), file: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Raw EDI 837 file upload"), allow_overwrite: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Override overwrite behavior for this request"), jobs: JobManager = Depends(get_job_manager), )
methods.description: Endpoint to queue processing of a single EDI 837 file, accepting file upload or blob reference.

methods.name: JobResponse process_batch( payload: BatchProcessRequest = Body(...), jobs: JobManager = Depends(get_job_manager), )
methods.description: Endpoint to queue processing of a batch of EDI 837 files based on a batch request.

methods.name: JobStatusResponse get_job_status( job_id: str = Path(..., description="The job identifier"), jobs: JobManager = Depends(get_job_manager), )
methods.description: Retrieve the status of a background job by its ID.
